name: Scroll of Messaging
summary: The Scroll of Messaging is an enchanted parchment carrying a specific magical sending spell. Acquired for the gnome engineer Gaxim Rustfizzle in the Stonetalon Mountains, it serves an unusual purpose: providing the magical trigger needed to detonate remote explosives.

sections.title: A Volatile Message
sections.body: While ostensibly an arcane script meant for long-distance communication, Gaxim Rustfizzle has a far more disruptive application in mind for the Scroll of Messaging. By combining its transmission incantation with volatile NG-5 charges, the gnome plans to create a remotely detonated explosive. The resulting blast is intended to trigger a massive distraction at the Venture Company's logging operation in Stonetalon, granting operatives a window to slip past guards and pilfer proprietary engineering schematics and confidential correspondence.

faq.q: What is the Scroll of Messaging used for?
aliases: what does scroll of messaging do
faq.answer: Although written as a messaging spell, Gaxim Rustfizzle uses its transmission magic to craft a remote trigger. When combined with explosive NG-5, it allows him to set off a blast from a safe distance.

aliases: where do i bring scroll of messaging
faq.answer: The scroll is delivered to Gaxim Rustfizzle, an Alliance-aligned gnome engineer operating in the Stonetalon Mountains.

faq.q: Why does Gaxim need a remote explosive?
faq.answer: Gaxim needs a major diversion at the local Venture Company operation. The resulting chaos provides cover to infiltrate their compound, steal valuable engineering plans, and recover documents to halt their aggressive clear-cutting of the forest.
NG-5 is an explosive chemical charge utilized by Gaxim Rustfizzle. Paired with the magical signal inscribed upon the Scroll of Messaging, it forms an improvised remote-detonation device.

angles.text: True to gnomish innovation, this scroll demonstrates how theoretical arcane magic can be repurposed as a remote receiver for mechanical demolitions.
The scroll plays a critical part in helping Alliance operatives sabotage Venture Company machinery and stall their environmental devastation in Stonetalon.
